description: This file defines a PHP class 'Numbers_Words_en_GB' for converting numbers into British English words, including properties for locale, language, and number exponents, as well as a method 'toWords' for performing the conversion.

classes.name: Numbers_Words_en_GB
classes.description: A class extending 'Numbers_Words' to spell out numbers in British English, with properties for locale, language, and number naming conventions, and a method to convert numeric values to words.

methods.name: toWords
methods.description: Converts a numeric value into its British English word representation, handling negative numbers, large exponents, and special cases for tens and units.
